tools.name: shipstation_list_orders
tools.description: List orders with status, dates, ship-to address, items, totals, carrier choice and tag ids. Filter by order number (starts-with), customer name, SKU keyword, status, store and date ranges. Use it to find an orderId for the other order tools. ShipStation API: GET /orders.

tools.name: shipstation_get_order
tools.description: Get one order by its ShipStation orderId, with items, addresses, notes and advanced options. ShipStation API: GET /orders/{orderId}.

tools.name: shipstation_list_orders_by_tag
tools.description: List orders that have a given status and tag. Get tag ids from shipstation_list_tags. ShipStation API: GET /orders/listbytag.

tools.name: shipstation_create_or_update_order
tools.description: Create an order, or update one when orderKey matches an existing order. Without orderKey, every call creates a new order, so pass a stable orderKey to avoid duplicates. Only open orders (awaiting_payment, awaiting_shipment, on_hold) can be updated. The whole order must be sent: no partial updates. S

tools.name: shipstation_mark_order_shipped
tools.description: Mark an order as shipped without creating a label. notifyCustomer true emails the customer, so set it only when the user asks. ShipStation API: POST /orders/markasshipped.

tools.name: shipstation_hold_order
tools.description: Put an order on hold until a date; it returns to awaiting_shipment on that date. ShipStation API: POST /orders/holduntil.

tools.name: shipstation_restore_order_from_hold
tools.description: Move an on-hold order back to awaiting_shipment now. ShipStation API: POST /orders/restorefromhold.

tools.name: shipstation_add_order_tag
tools.description: Add a tag to an order. Get tag ids from shipstation_list_tags. ShipStation API: POST /orders/addtag.

tools.name: shipstation_remove_order_tag
tools.description: Remove a tag from an order. ShipStation API: POST /orders/removetag.

tools.name: shipstation_list_shipments
tools.description: List shipments with labels created in ShipStation: carrier, service, tracking number, ship and void dates, recipient. Orders marked shipped outside ShipStation do not appear (use shipstation_list_fulfillments). ShipStation API: GET /shipments.

tools.name: shipstation_list_fulfillments
tools.description: List orders marked shipped, in ShipStation or through the API, with tracking numbers and ship dates. ShipStation API: GET /fulfillments.

tools.name: shipstation_list_carriers
tools.description: List the shipping carrier accounts connected to this ShipStation account, with account numbers and balances. ShipStation API: GET /carriers.

tools.name: shipstation_get_carrier
tools.description: Get one connected carrier account by carrier code, including its balance. ShipStation API: GET /carriers/getcarrier.

tools.name: shipstation_list_carrier_services
tools.description: List the shipping services a carrier offers (for example fedex_ground), with domestic and international flags. ShipStation API: GET /carriers/listservices.

tools.name: shipstation_list_carrier_packages
tools.description: List the package types a carrier supports (for example flat_rate_envelope). ShipStation API: GET /carriers/listpackages.

tools.name: shipstation_get_shipping_rates
tools.description: Get shipping rates for a parcel from a carrier. This quotes only; it buys no label. Weight and the destination are required. ShipStation API: POST /shipments/getrates.

tools.name: shipstation_list_products
tools.description: List products in the catalog with SKU, name, price, dimensions, weight, default carrier and warehouse location. Filter by SKU, name, UPC, category, type, tag or creation dates. ShipStation API: GET /products.

tools.name: shipstation_get_product
tools.description: Get one product by productId, with its default carrier, service and package codes. ShipStation API: GET /products/{productId}.

tools.name: shipstation_list_stores
tools.description: List the sales-channel stores connected to this account, with marketplace, active flag and refresh dates. ShipStation API: GET /stores.

tools.name: shipstation_get_store
tools.description: Get one connected store by storeId, with its status mappings. ShipStation API: GET /stores/{storeId}.

tools.name: shipstation_get_store_refresh_status
tools.description: Get whether a store is refreshing its orders now, and when it last refreshed. ShipStation API: GET /stores/getrefreshstatus.

tools.name: shipstation_list_customers
tools.description: List customers with name, address, email and marketplace usernames. Filter by state, country, marketplace or tag. ShipStation API: GET /customers.

tools.name: shipstation_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer by customerId, with address and marketplace usernames. ShipStation API: GET /customers/{customerId}.

tools.name: shipstation_list_users
tools.description: List the ShipStation user accounts on this account (names and user ids), for order assignment. ShipStation API: GET /users.

tools.name: shipstation_list_warehouses
tools.description: List ship-from locations (the API calls them warehouses), with origin and return addresses. ShipStation API: GET /warehouses.

tools.name: shipstation_list_webhooks
tools.description: List the webhooks registered on this account: event type, target URL, store and active flag. ShipStation API: GET /webhooks.

tools.name: shipstation_list_tags
tools.description: List the order and customer tags defined on this account, with tag ids and colors. Use the ids in the tag tools. ShipStation API: GET /accounts/listtags.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: shipstation_create_or_update_order, shipstation_add_order_tag, shipstation_get_shipping_rates, shipstation_list_customers, shipstation_list_webhooks · Public sink: shipstation_create_or_update_order, shipstation_mark_order_shipped, shipstation_hold_order, shipstation_restore_order_from_hold, shipstation_add_order_tag, shipstation_remove_order_tag, shipstation_get_shipping_rates, shipstation_list_customers · Destructive: shipstation_remove_order_tag.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: shipstation_create_or_update_order, shipstation_add_order_tag, shipstation_get_shipping_rates, shipstation_list_customers, shipstation_list_webhooks · Public sink: shipstation_create_or_update_order, shipstation_mark_order_shipped, shipstation_hold_order, shipstation_restore_order_from_hold, shipstation_add_order_tag, shipstation_remove_order_tag, shipstation_get_shipping_rates, shipstation_list_customers · Destructive: shipstation_remove_order_tag

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
